what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from the United States in Canada: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2820 American asylum seekers in Canada, 74.6% of all asylum seekers from the United States.
Refugees from the United States, a separate group, live mostly in Canada, Spain, Germany and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of the United States of America with al-Qaida from 2001 to 2017 and in 2019.
The fact pack does not link that conflict to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 86 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data include 2017 to 2020 and 2024 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Canada only.
